colorException.reason: Matches upstream exactly: a native <option> popup is painted by the OS outside the page's own CSS custom properties, so only the CSS Canvas/CanvasText system-color keywords (resolved by the OS per its own theme) keep option text legible there -- adico's background/foreground tokens would not apply.

inspirationNote: Class-for-class match with upstream's NativeSelect/NativeSelectOption/NativeSelectOptGroup, including the deliberate Canvas/CanvasText system-color exception recorded above. No dioxus-components equivalent exists.
